definitions.explanation: A small cell fragment in the blood that plays a key role in clotting and wound healing.

examples.japanese: {血小板|けっしょうばん}の{数|かず}が{少|すく}ない。
{血小板|けっしょうばん}は{出血|しゅっけつ}を{止|と}める{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす。
examples.english: Platelets play the role of stopping bleeding.

examples.japanese: {血液検査|けつえきけんさ}の{結果|けっか}、{血小板|けっしょうばん}の{値|あたい}が{正常|せいじょう}{範囲|はんい}より{低|ひく}かったため{再検査|さいけんさ}となった。
examples.english: The blood test results showed the platelet value was below the normal range, so a retest was scheduled.

notes:
A medical term composed of {血|けつ} (blood), {小|しょう} (small), and {板|ばん} (plate). Platelets are one of three main components of blood along with {赤血球|せっけっきゅう} (red blood cells) and {白血球|はっけっきゅう} (white blood cells). Learners may encounter this word at doctor's visits or when reading blood test results in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {血小板|けっしょうばん}の{数|かず} / {血小板|けっしょうばん}{数|すう} — platelet count
- {血小板|けっしょうばん}が{減少|げんしょう}する — platelets decrease
- {血小板|けっしょうばん}{輸血|ゆけつ} — platelet transfusion
- {血小板|けっしょうばん}{凝集|ぎょうしゅう} — platelet aggregation

RELATED WORDS:
- {赤血球|せっけっきゅう} — red blood cell
- {白血球|はっけっきゅう} — white blood cell
- {血液|けつえき} — blood
